turns.customer: I ordered two Swift 30 daypacks on #1351 but only need one. Can I send one back? Both are unused.
turns.reply: Yes, one of your Swift 30 Daypacks is eligible for return since it is unused and in its original packaging. You can initiate the return by generating a return label in your account and sending it back by October 6, 2026. Once the warehouse receives the item, they will process your refund.
